instruction: Could you help me increase the saturation of the image to make colors more vibrant?

metadata.explanation: Task requires increasing the saturation of the image to make colors more vibrant. Evaluator uses custom getter to calculate average saturation from HSV color space and metric to verify it increased from the original value. Verified original image saturation: 66.13 (calculated from HSV conversion). Similar complexity to original palette conversion task.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts saturation from HSV color space, which is the standard method for measuring color saturation
Metric correctly compares result saturation against original value (66.13) to verify increase
Data flow is semantically correct: getter extracts saturation from exported image -> metric compares against original baseline
Postconfig appropriately exports the modified image (Shift+Ctrl+E) to a known location for verification
Complete coverage: instruction requires 'increase saturation', evaluator checks exactly this requirement
Expected value (66.13) is correctly calculated from the original image HSV conversion
Tolerance of 5.0 is reasonable for distinguishing meaningful saturation changes
Partial credit scoring (1.0 for increase, 0.5 for no change, 0.0 for decrease) is logically sound
No parameter handling errors: metric correctly accesses expected.get('original_saturation')
Logic will work correctly at runtime with proper edge case handling (None checks)
